pass_means: ONLY active reference W_w_jet_pullback_via_Pi_tr_o68: ⟨Pi_w^R,f⟩=⟨Pi_tr^R,W_w f⟩ with explicit even non-Lorentz w (R=1); restriction+normalization lemmas; continuity; off-diagonal (iκ²/4)T; sd≤8 via annular seminorms; even; vanishing moments |γ|≤4. Old cutoff ARCHIVED; equivalence NOT claimed.

reference.restriction: If f vanishes on a neighborhood of 0 (hence supp f ⊂ U and jet through order 4 at 0 vanishes), then J_4 f = 0 and W_w f = f.
reference.normalization: For p_gamma = z^gamma/gamma! with |gamma|<=4 and w≡1 near 0: J_4(w p_gamma) = p_gamma globally (jet of w p_gamma at 0 equals jet of p_gamma because w(0)=1 and all derivatives of w that hit the product vanish at 0 when w≡1 on a neighborhood of 0). Hence W_w(w p_gamma) = w p_gamma - w J_4(w p_gamma) = w p_gamma - w p_gamma = 0 globally as a test function (including the transition region and outside supp w).
reference.distinction: Active reference pulls back the already-extended transverse Pi_tr^R through W_w; it is not the dyadic cutoff-limit of the punctured T. XIII-C / XVI-J prove restriction+normalization after Pi_tr exists; equivalence with cutoff is not claimed.

w.formula: rho(s)=0 (s<=0), exp(-1/s) (s>0); eta(s)=rho(s)/(rho(s)+rho(1-s)); u=1-|z|_E^2/R^2 with R=1 (chart length); w(z)=eta(2u). Explicit: w≡1 on |z|_E^2<=1/2; w≡0 on |z|_E>=1; C^∞ monotone on the transition annulus 1/2<|z|_E^2<1.
w.interpolation: eta(2u) with eta the standard smooth step via rho
w.even_proof: w(-z)=w(z) because |z|_E depends on squared coordinates
w.why_not_Lorentz: No nonzero compactly supported Lorentz-invariant smooth function equals 1 near 0 (unbounded Lorentz orbits).
w.parameterized_alternative: Equivalently the theorem may be stated for arbitrary admissible even w≡1 near 0, writing L = L_{mu,w}; this release freezes the explicit formula above.

W_w.formula: W_w f = f - w * J_4 f
W_w.restriction_lemma: If f vanishes on a neighborhood of 0 (hence supp f ⊂ U and jet through order 4 at 0 vanishes), then J_4 f = 0 and W_w f = f.
W_w.normalization_lemma: For p_gamma = z^gamma/gamma! with |gamma|<=4 and w≡1 near 0: J_4(w p_gamma) = p_gamma globally (jet of w p_gamma at 0 equals jet of p_gamma because w(0)=1 and all derivatives of w that hit the product vanish at 0 when w≡1 on a neighborhood of 0). Hence W_w(w p_gamma) = w p_gamma - w J_4(w p_gamma) = w p_gamma - w p_gamma = 0 globally as a test function (including the transition region and outside supp w).

J_4.formula: J_4 f(z) = sum_{|gamma|<=4} z^gamma/gamma! * partial^gamma f(0)

continuity.argument: W_w: D→D continuous; Pi_tr^R ∈ D' ⇒ composition continuous. Proofs use annular seminorms (XIII-C), not a pointwise bound.

agrees_off_diagonal.statement: If f vanishes near 0 then J_4 f = 0, W_w f = f, and ⟨Pi_w,f⟩=⟨Pi_tr,f⟩=⟨(i κ^2/4) T, f⟩.

scaling_degree.argument: Pi_tr^R has sd≤8; W_w subtracts a jet against compact w without raising sd (XIII-C annular seminorms).

evenness.argument: Pi_tr^R even (even u_mu^R, even-order K); w even ⇒ W_w intertwines parity; Pi_w even. Odd moments vanish only after this evenness is proved — not by a metadata flag.

vanishing_moments.proof: J_4(w p_gamma)=p_gamma globally ⇒ W_w(w p_gamma)=0 globally (normalization lemma, including transition region); hence ⟨Pi_tr, W_w(w p_gamma)⟩=0.
